start: Paste text into DeepL Write, inspect the suggested corrections, then select a style or tone and apply only the revisions you approve.

name: LanguageTool
description: Grammar, spelling, punctuation, style, and tone assistant with web editor, browser and document add-ons, paraphrasing, and developer APIs.
bestFor: Real-time proofreading in email, documents, CMS editors, and social or web apps.
Writers who want grammar and style explanations, personal dictionary support, and consistent wording.
Users rewriting sentences into more formal, fluent, or concise variants with the AI paraphraser.
Teams and developers embedding multilingual language checks through the hosted or self-hosted API.
strengths: Checks spelling, grammar, punctuation, word choice, style, and tone across 30+ languages, with deeper Premium checks for key languages.
Browser extensions support Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Opera and work across sites such as Gmail, Google Docs, WordPress, and social platforms.
Premium adds unlimited AI sentence paraphrasing, a style guide, personal dictionary, larger text fields, and more than 20,000 additional checks.
The public and Premium APIs support grammar, style, and spelling checks; text language can be detected automatically and rules can be disabled.
LanguageTool offers an open-source server that can be self-hosted for organizations needing control over processing and deployment.
LanguageTool says API text is not stored and its hosted servers are in Germany; review the current privacy policy for integrations and account data.
gettingStarted: Open the web editor at languagetool.org or install the browser, Microsoft Word, Google Docs, desktop, or mobile add-on you need.
Paste or type text, inspect each highlighted suggestion and explanation, then accept, ignore, or add exceptions to your personal dictionary.
Use the style and tone suggestions to improve clarity, then open Paraphrasing for a formal, fluent, or shorter rewrite when appropriate.
For an application integration, create the appropriate API plan, review the developer docs, and send bounded text to the proofreading endpoint.
For private infrastructure, deploy the open-source LanguageTool server and point your integration or editor at its HTTP API.
usageNotes: Free users get basic checks and limited AI paraphrasing; Premium limits, language coverage, and pricing change, so check the live plan page.
Language suggestions are not factual verification. Keep human review for names, numbers, citations, code, medical or legal wording.
API limits vary by plan: official help currently lists 20 vs 80 requests/minute, 75,000 vs 300,000 characters/minute, and 20,000 vs 60,000 characters/request for free vs Premium.
Hosted API and self-hosted server are different deployment choices; self-hosting requires operating and securing your own service.
Some apps have only browser-extension support rather than native integration; verify the supported-app list before promising a workflow.
Review third-party integration permissions and privacy policies before sending confidential content through connected services.
priceDetails: Freemium: basic checks are available free, while Premium adds expanded checks, unlimited paraphrasing, larger text limits, style guides, and higher API quotas. Team and enterprise plans are available.
install: Use the web editor, install an official browser/Word/Google Docs add-on, or deploy the open-source server from https://dev.languagetool.org/.
start: Open the editor or an integration, enter text, and review the highlighted grammar and style suggestions before applying them.

name: Typeface
description: Enterprise marketing AI platform that grounds multimodal agents and content workflows in brand guidelines, approved assets, audience context, and governed business data.
bestFor: Marketing teams planning and producing on-brand campaigns across email, ads, web, and retail channels.
Enterprise creative teams creating and adapting image and copy variations while keeping each brand or sub-brand consistent.
IT and operations teams turning repeatable marketing processes into reusable agents with approvals, checks, APIs, and integrations.
Organizations that need centralized brand intelligence, collaboration, review, publishing, personalization, and governance.
strengths: Arc Graph grounds outputs in brand guidelines, approved layouts, assets, audiences, and business context.
Arc Agents orchestrate complex tasks across campaign planning, creation, adaptation, review, and publishing.
Arc Spaces provides a visual workspace for planning, collaboration, approvals, and channel delivery.
Arc Forge turns workflows into custom agents and extends steps through MCP, APIs, connectors, and integrations.
Supports multimodal, multi-channel content and localized variations while maintaining distinct brand identities.
Enterprise controls include human-in-the-loop review, brand governance, content isolation, encryption, access controls, responsible-AI guardrails, and C2PA support.
gettingStarted: Request a demo or access through your organization at typeface.ai; Typeface is positioned as an enterprise platform rather than a self-serve consumer editor.
Define brand kits, approved assets, style rules, audiences, and campaign objectives before asking agents to generate content.
Start in an Arc Space with one campaign, review drafts and variations, and route outputs through the team approval workflow.
Use Arc Agents for repeatable tasks and Arc Forge when you need to connect internal systems, MCP tools, APIs, or custom checks.
Keep a human owner responsible for factual claims, rights to source assets, brand compliance, accessibility, and final publishing.
usageNotes: Pricing is sales-led and enterprise-oriented; request a current quote and confirm which Arc modules, seats, channels, and integrations are included.
Outputs are brand-grounded but still generative: review claims, legal language, trademarks, accessibility, and image rights before publishing.
Connectors and APIs can move business and customer data; configure least-privilege access, retention, and approval boundaries before production use.
Typeface describes dedicated models, data isolation, encryption, and strict access controls, but verify contractual security and residency terms for your plan.
The product is cloud-hosted and requires an account or organization access; no public self-serve local runtime was verified.
Creative integrations include Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator; ecosystem integrations also span Salesforce, Microsoft, Google, and other systems.
priceDetails: Enterprise, sales-led pricing. Contact Typeface for a demo and quote; current public pricing was not listed.
install: Open https://www.typeface.ai/ and request access or a demo. Configure integrations through the organization’s Typeface workspace.
start: Create a brand-grounded workspace, add approved context and assets, then run a small campaign workflow through review before scaling.

name: Gamma
description: AI workspace for generating and editing presentations, documents, websites, social posts, and graphics from prompts, outlines, or imported files.
bestFor: Fast first drafts of pitch decks, keynotes, proposals, reports, and training documents.
Responsive microsites and social content created from the same source material.
Teams that need themes, brand assets, collaboration, sharing, analytics, and exports to common presentation formats.
Developers and automation builders generating content programmatically through the Gamma API, MCP, Zapier, Make, or n8n.
strengths: Generate, Paste, or Import modes turn prompts, existing text, PDFs, PPTX files, and web pages into structured content.
AI handles copy, layouts, images, themes, translations, and iterative slide or document edits.
Create presentations, visual documents, hosted websites, social posts, and custom graphics in one workspace.
Share live links, present from Gamma, publish websites, track engagement, or export to PDF, PPTX, PNG, Google Slides, and (for documents) Word.
Pro plans expose the Generate API and OAuth; Gamma also offers MCP and automation connectors.
Free and paid plans use AI credits; higher tiers add larger generations, custom branding/domains, advanced models, analytics, and more usage.
gettingStarted: Create a free Gamma account and choose Presentation, Document, Webpage, Social Post, or Image.
Pick Generate for a prompt, Paste for existing copy, or Import for a PDF, PPTX, document, or webpage.
Describe audience, goal, format, tone, brand, and source constraints; then choose a theme and generate.
Edit manually or use Gamma’s AI assistant to rewrite, translate, add layouts, and refine individual cards/slides.
Share a link, present, publish, or export; inspect the final file in its target app before delivery.
usageNotes: Free plans include starter AI credits and smaller generations; limits, branding, exports, and model access depend on the current plan.
Generated copy, charts, citations, and images need human fact-checking and rights/accessibility review.
PPTX and Google Slides exports may require visual cleanup because Gamma layouts do not map perfectly to every external editor.
API and connector calls consume credits; use OAuth or scoped credentials and avoid sending confidential source material without approval.
Gamma is cloud-hosted and account-based; no local/offline runtime was verified.
priceDetails: Freemium plans with AI credits. Paid Plus, Pro, and Ultra tiers add higher generation limits, remove branding, premium models, custom branding/domains, analytics, API access, and advanced usage.
install: Open https://gamma.app/ and create an account. Developers can use https://developers.gamma.app/ for API or MCP integrations.
start: Create New AI, choose a content type, then Generate, Paste, or Import your source material.

name: Beautiful.ai
description: AI presentation platform with outline-first generation, auto-aligning Smart Slides, brand controls, collaboration, analytics, and editable exports.
bestFor: Pitch decks, sales proposals, strategy updates, keynotes, and internal presentations that need polished design quickly.
Teams standardizing fonts, colors, logos, themes, layouts, and slide libraries across recurring decks.
Presenters who want AI to draft, rewrite, summarize, visualize, and refine content while retaining slide-level control.
Developers and automation teams generating work-ready decks through the early-access API or MCP connector.
strengths: Create with AI turns a prompt, brief, outline, or imported document into an editable deck with an outline review step.
Smart Slides automatically align, resize, and animate content as you edit, with 300+ layout patterns.
Shared themes, locked brand elements, slide libraries, permissions, and real-time collaboration support consistent team output.
Built-in charts, data visualizations, stock images/video, AI visuals, animation, narration, and viewer analytics cover the full presentation workflow.
Export decks as editable PPTX, PDF, PNG, or upload PPTX to Google Slides; present and share live links from Beautiful.ai.
The prompt-to-deck API and MCP connector can create, search, summarize, and export presentations, but API access is early access and plan-gated.
gettingStarted: Start a trial or sign in at beautiful.ai, then choose Create with AI or begin from a template/Smart Slide.
Describe the audience, objective, storyline, constraints, and brand context; review and edit the generated outline before slide design.
Apply a shared theme and approved assets, then refine content with AI or manually while checking every chart, claim, and image.
Invite collaborators, use permissions and slide libraries, and route the deck through your team’s review process.
Present from Beautiful.ai, share a live link, or export to PPTX/PDF/PNG and inspect the result in the target app.
For automation, request API/MCP access, store credentials securely, and test generated decks before publishing.
usageNotes: A 14-day trial and paid individual, team, and enterprise plans are available; free/trial branding, credits, exports, and limits can change.
Auto-layout preserves design consistency but may require manual cleanup after complex edits or external PPTX conversion.
Verify facts, citations, chart calculations, speaker notes, accessibility, and image licensing before presenting externally.
API access is early access and requires a Bearer API key; export endpoints return temporary signed download URLs.
MCP does not provide arbitrary slide-by-slide editing of an existing presentation; check connector capabilities for your workflow.
Cloud processing and collaboration can expose deck content to workspace members and integrations; configure permissions and review security terms.
priceDetails: Paid plans for individuals, teams, and enterprise, with a free trial. Pricing and API availability are plan-dependent; current public pages advertise Pro from $12/month and custom sales plans.
install: Open https://www.beautiful.ai/ and start a trial, or install the official PowerPoint integration. Developers can review https://docs.beautiful.ai/.
start: Create Presentation → Create with AI, enter a prompt or import source material, review the outline, choose a theme, and generate.

name: Pitch
description: Collaborative AI presentation workspace for creating, editing, presenting, sharing, and analyzing on-brand decks.
bestFor: Sales, fundraising, strategy, product, and team decks built collaboratively in real time or asynchronously.
Individuals starting from Pitch Agent, expert templates, a blank canvas, or an imported PPTX.
Teams standardizing custom templates, fonts, colors, assets, slide styles, and reusable content.
Presenters sharing live links, pitch rooms, embeds, and engagement analytics with prospects or stakeholders.
strengths: Pitch Agent generates a complete presentation from a prompt, uploaded context, and a chosen template, then supports chat-based refinement.
100+ expert templates, custom templates, brand fonts, colors, and reusable styles accelerate consistent deck creation.
Real-time collaboration, comments, guests, teamspaces, presenter view, speaker notes, animations, embeds, and version history support delivery.
Integrations include Google Sheets, Google Analytics, ChartMogul, HubSpot, Unsplash, Giphy, Brandfetch, YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, and Notion sharing.
Free plans allow unlimited presentations; paid plans add recurring AI credits, unbranded PPTX/PDF exports, advanced links, analytics, teamspaces, and pitch rooms.
Pitch offers MCP and API workflows for developers and AI assistants; actions consume workspace AI credits and depend on plan/quota.
gettingStarted: Create a free Pitch workspace and choose Create with AI, a template, or Import to upload an existing PPTX.
Describe the audience, objective, storyline, content constraints, and desired visual style; review the generated outline and slides.
Apply your team template, brand fonts, colors, and approved media, then collaborate through comments and roles.
Connect data sources when needed, verify charts and numbers, and add speaker notes or a presenter view.
Share a live link or pitch room, present from Pitch, or export to PDF/PPTX and inspect the exported deck before sending.
For automation, connect the official MCP/API flow and protect credentials; confirm that your plan includes the required AI quota.
usageNotes: Free includes unlimited presentations and a non-renewing starter AI-credit pack; paid plans renew monthly AI credits and vary by seats and features.
PPTX/PDF export availability and Pitch branding depend on plan; external editing may require visual cleanup.
AI-generated content and charts still require fact-checking, source attribution, accessibility, and image-rights review.
Advanced links and pitch rooms can expose engagement data such as visits, slide views, and time spent; configure sharing intentionally.
Pitch is cloud-based and account/workspace access is required; no local offline authoring runtime was verified in the reviewed materials.
MCP/API actions can create or fill templates but feature availability is plan- and quota-dependent.
priceDetails: Freemium. Free supports unlimited presentations; Plus, Team, and Business plans add monthly AI credits, unbranded exports, collaboration, analytics, teamspaces, pitch rooms, and higher guest limits. Current pricing is seat-based and billed monthly or annually.
install: Open https://pitch.com/ and sign up, or use the Pitch desktop app linked from the product site.
start: Create a presentation → choose Pitch Agent, a template, or Import PPTX → review, edit, collaborate, then share or export.

name: SlidesAI
description: AI presentation maker that turns prompts, notes, text, and documents into editable decks in Google Slides, PowerPoint, ChatGPT, or its web app.
bestFor: Students, educators, professionals, and teams turning notes, scripts, PDFs, or documents into structured presentations quickly.
Users who want to review an outline before slide generation and then refine individual slides with AI.
Teams applying custom themes, fonts, colors, brand kits, layouts, charts, and diagrams across decks.
Presenters who need native Google Slides or PowerPoint workflows with export to PPTX or PDF.
strengths: Generate from a prompt, topic, notes, pasted text, or uploaded document, with an outline review step before slides are built.
AI can rewrite, rephrase, shorten, translate, or regenerate individual slides and add AI or stock images.
Works as a web app, Google Slides add-on, Microsoft PowerPoint add-in, and ChatGPT integration; supports 100+ languages.
Brand kits centralize colors, fonts, logos, and slide styles; charts, Mermaid diagrams, animations, and transitions are supported.
Decks remain editable in Google Slides and PowerPoint and can be exported to PPTX, Google Slides, or PDF and shared or embedded.
Official help materials document free, Pro, and Premium tiers with AI-credit and presentation limits.
gettingStarted: Open the web app or install the official Google Slides add-on, PowerPoint add-in, or ChatGPT integration.
Choose Generate from prompt/topic, notes, text, or uploaded document; specify audience, goal, tone, slide count, and visual style.
Review and correct the proposed outline before generating the full deck, then apply a theme or brand kit.
Refine slide text with Rewrite, Rephrase, Shorten, or Translate; replace visuals and verify charts and diagrams.
Edit collaboratively in Google Slides or PowerPoint, then export/share/embed the finished presentation.
usageNotes: The Basic tier currently includes 12 presentations/year, 1,000 input characters/presentation, and 120 AI credits/year; paid limits vary by plan and region.
Pro and Premium add document upload, larger input limits, recurring credits, and more presentations; check live pricing before purchase.
AI-generated facts, citations, diagrams, images, and translations require human review for accuracy, accessibility, and rights.
Exports and watermark removal depend on the plan; inspect PPTX/PDF rendering in the destination app before delivery.
Google Slides and PowerPoint add-ins run under the signed-in account that owns or edits the presentation; check account identity before generating.
Cloud account access is required for the normal workflow; no public developer API was verified in the official materials reviewed.
priceDetails: Freemium. Basic is free with limited annual presentations, input characters, and AI credits; Pro and Premium are paid plans with document upload, higher limits, and recurring credits. Team and institution plans are also available.
install: Open https://www.slidesai.io/ or install SlidesAI from Google Workspace Marketplace, Microsoft AppSource, or its ChatGPT integration.
start: Create a presentation, enter a prompt or source text/document, review the outline, then generate and edit the slides.

name: Plus AI
description: AI presentation assistant that creates native Google Slides and PowerPoint decks, inserts individual slides, rewrites content, and remixes existing layouts.
bestFor: Professional presentation makers who want AI inside their existing Google Slides or PowerPoint workflow.
Turning prompts, articles, PDFs, Word files, text, or existing decks into editable slides.
Reformatting dense or inconsistent slides into clear layouts while preserving control over the final deck.
Teams using custom templates, shared slide libraries, brand assets, and repeatable presentation workflows.
strengths: Generates complete decks or one slide at a time from prompts and source documents.
Insert, Rewrite, and Remix actions add layouts, condense or expand copy, change tone, fix grammar, translate, and reformat existing slides.
Creates native PowerPoint and Google Slides presentations compatible with existing editing and collaboration tools.
Supports custom templates, logos, fonts, colors, shared presets, asset libraries, charts, icons, and AI-generated visuals.
Works directly in Google Slides and PowerPoint, with optional API, Zapier, and MCP access for automation.
SOC 2 Type II compliance and encryption in transit/at rest are documented for business workflows.
gettingStarted: Install the Plus AI add-on in Google Slides from Extensions, or add Plus AI from Home → Add-ins in PowerPoint.
Sign in and choose New Presentation, then start with a prompt, paste text, or upload a PDF, DOCX, PPTX, or text file.
Specify audience, objective, tone, slide count, source constraints, and a preferred template before generating.
Review the outline and draft, then use Insert, Rewrite, or Remix to refine individual slides and layouts.
Apply brand templates and shared assets, verify data and visuals, then collaborate and present in the host app.
For automation, request API/Zapier/MCP access, protect credentials, and confirm your plan’s credit quota.
usageNotes: All paid plans start with a 7-day trial and 1,000 AI credits; paid tiers use recurring monthly credits and are billed per user.
Current public pricing lists Basic at $10/user/month annually ($15 monthly), with higher tiers and enterprise customization available; verify live pricing.
AI credits vary by task (the pricing page estimates roughly 40–170 credits per task), so large decks can exhaust quotas quickly.
Native exports remain editable, but always inspect formatting, charts, citations, and speaker notes before delivery.
Plus AI is cloud-connected and account-based; do not upload confidential material without checking workspace policy and security terms.
API access is separate from the editor and can create native PowerPoint slides; no claim of unlimited or offline use should be made.
priceDetails: 7-day free trial with 1,000 AI credits, then paid per-user Basic, Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Basic is publicly listed at $10/user/month when billed annually or $15 monthly; limits and features vary.
install: Install Plus AI for Google Slides or PowerPoint from the official product links at https://plusai.com/; web access is also available.
start: Open a Google Slides or PowerPoint deck, launch Plus AI, choose New Presentation, and provide a prompt or source file.

name: Decktopus
description: End-to-end AI presentation and carousel platform that generates structure, content, visuals, branding, speaker notes, and delivery practice from a topic or uploaded file.
bestFor: Pitch decks, sales presentations, training materials, reports, and carousels created from an idea, notes, or business document.
Teams applying brand colors, fonts, and logos automatically from a website URL and reviewing decks together.
Presenters who want built-in speaker notes, version history, live sharing, analytics, and an AI rehearsal coach.
Users exporting an editable PPT, fixed PDF, or slide-by-slide PNG after reviewing the generated draft.
strengths: Studio generates a complete presentation or carousel from a topic or uploaded file, including outline, copy, design, and visuals.
The outline can be reviewed before generation; Edit with AI rewrites headlines, swaps images, adjusts layouts, and preserves manual editing.
Paste a website URL to pull brand colors, fonts, and logo into the deck without manual setup.
Loop provides AI-assisted rehearsal and delivery feedback; version history tracks changes and supports restoration.
Present in the browser, share a live link, collect leads, inspect slide engagement analytics, or export PDF, PPT, and PNG.
Supports multilingual generation, stock/AI imagery, mobile access, and a fresh-from-topic workflow rather than only fixed templates.
gettingStarted: Create an account at decktopus.com and open Studio; new accounts receive limited credits to try a first deck.
Enter a topic or upload notes, a draft, business plan, PDF, or other source file, then specify audience and purpose.
Review and edit the generated outline, choose or import brand context, and generate the full deck or carousel.
Use Edit with AI or manual editing to refine copy, visuals, layouts, citations, and speaker notes.
Run through Loop to rehearse delivery, then present, share a live link, export, or review analytics after distribution.
usageNotes: Decktopus does not offer an unlimited free plan; the first deck can be tried with credits but exports may be watermarked or unavailable without a subscription.
Current Pro pricing lists 750 AI credits/month (about 150 slides), with Business adding shared workspace, Brand Kit, analytics, custom domain, priority support, and 1,000 credits/seat/month.
Generation uses credits (the pitch-deck page lists about 5 credits per generated slide and per AI edit); quotas and prices can change.
AI-generated content, visuals, notes, and charts still require fact-checking, source attribution, accessibility review, and image-rights checks.
PPT exports are editable but may need cleanup in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides; verify animations and layout after export.
Cloud account access is required; review workspace permissions, lead collection, analytics, and data-training settings before uploading confidential material.
priceDetails: Credit-based paid plans. Pro is publicly listed at $24.99/month monthly, $19.99/month on 3-month billing, or $9.99/month when billed annually ($119.88/year); Business and Enterprise add team and governance features.
install: Open https://www.decktopus.com/ and create an account; no local installation is required for the web workflow.
start: Open Studio, enter a topic or upload a file, review the outline, generate the deck, then edit or rehearse with Loop.

name: Presentations.AI
description: AI presentation platform that turns prompts, documents, URLs, and data into branded, editable decks with native PowerPoint export, live updates, and analytics.
bestFor: Pitch decks, sales proposals, board reports, product launches, course material, and other business presentations.
Teams creating on-brand decks from a master template and refreshing data or audience context without redesigning the narrative.
Users starting from a prompt, PDF, Word document, URL, YouTube video, spreadsheet, or existing PowerPoint file.
Organizations needing editable PPTX/PDF delivery, live links, collaboration, embeds, and presentation tracking.
strengths: Generates slide copy, layouts, visuals, and design from prompts or imported source material, often in under a minute.
Brand Sync pulls logo, fonts, and colors from a website URL; master templates and update rules keep fixed design separate from changing data.
Anti-fragile templates recalculate spacing and hierarchy as content changes, keeping slides editable and consistent.
Refresh can update data, prospect context, or audience-specific content while preserving the locked narrative and design.
Native PPTX export keeps editable text, shapes, layouts, fonts, and charts; PDF, link, and embed sharing are also supported.
Real-time collaboration, engagement analytics, accuracy checks against source material, live data connections, and 1,000+ templates support production workflows.
gettingStarted: Create a free account at presentations.ai and choose a template or start from a prompt, URL, document, or data source.
Describe the audience, goal, storyline, constraints, and brand context; review the generated flow and edit each slide.
Set up Brand Sync or import a master presentation, then define which narrative and design elements must stay fixed.
Connect approved data sources or project knowledge for charts, research, and audience-specific variants; verify every update.
Collaborate, share a live link or embed, present, and export to editable PPTX/PDF after visual QA in PowerPoint or Google Slides.
usageNotes: Starter includes 100 credits and up to 20 slides; Pro is listed at $20/month billed annually with 5,000 credits, while Gold is $100/month billed annually with 50,000 credits.
AI credits, export quality, brand customization, analytics, agents, and model access vary by plan and may change by region.
Accuracy checks are useful signals, not a replacement for human verification of numbers, claims, citations, legal language, and data freshness.
Native PPTX is editable but still needs review for fonts, animations, charts, and layout when opened outside the platform.
Live data connectors and audience customization can expose business or customer information; use least privilege and approved sources.
Cloud account access is required; review SOC 2, data ownership, content retention, and workspace permissions before uploading confidential material.
priceDetails: Freemium credit-based plans: Starter $0 with 100 credits and up to 20 slides; Pro $20/month billed annually with 5,000 credits; Gold $100/month billed annually with 50,000 credits and frontier models/agents. Regional prices may vary.
install: Open https://www.presentations.ai/ and sign up; no local installation is required.
start: Enter a topic, paste a URL, or upload a document, review the generated structure, then edit, brand, share, or export the deck.

name: Prezi AI
description: AI presentation maker that turns prompts and uploaded files into dynamic, zooming Prezi visual stories, with text rewriting, image generation, and editable export.
bestFor: Presentations where a spatial, zooming narrative is more engaging than a conventional linear slide deck.
Teachers, trainers, marketers, consultants, and speakers starting from a prompt, PPTX, PDF, or DOCX.
Users who want AI to generate an outline and design, then refine text, images, frames, zoom paths, and styles in the editor.
Teams delivering live, recorded, portable, or PowerPoint/PDF versions of a visual presentation.
strengths: Prezi AI creates a complete outline and canvas-based design from a prompt or uploaded file, then lets you edit the result.
Ask AI can optimize or rewrite selected text; prompts can also generate original images and presentations in OpenAI-supported languages.
PPTX imports can be converted into a dynamic Prezi presentation or inserted as selected slides/frames into an existing canvas.
The zooming format, frames, paths, motion, and visual storytelling create a distinct alternative to linear slide tools.
Paid plans add privacy controls, premium media, desktop/offline access, PDF/PPT export, recording, presenter features, and analytics.
Prezi supports collaboration and share controls, while its AI workflow begins with free credits for exploration.
gettingStarted: Create a Prezi account and click Create with AI from the dashboard, or choose Start with PPTX, PDF, DOCX file.
Write a prompt of at least six words describing the audience, goal, storyline, and desired visual style.
Review and edit the generated outline, choose a color palette/design style, then create the presentation.
Open the editor to rewrite text, replace images, adjust frames and zoom paths, and verify the narrative flow.
Present live, record or share a link, or export to PPT/PDF when your plan supports it; inspect the result in the destination app.
usageNotes: Basic/free access includes limited AI credits (official plan guidance lists 500 credits and up to 10 talking points); Plus and Premium provide broader or unlimited AI access.
Current pricing lists Standard $7/month, Plus $19/month, and Premium $29/month when billed annually; regional prices and feature gates may vary.
AI-generated text, images, translations, and layouts require fact-checking, source attribution, accessibility review, and rights checks.
PPTX import uses slide text to build a new presentation; visual fidelity and structure can change during conversion, so review every frame.
Export, offline desktop use, analytics, privacy controls, and portable presentations are plan-dependent.
Cloud account and permissions are required for normal use; do not upload confidential source material without reviewing Prezi’s privacy and workspace controls.
priceDetails: Freemium with limited AI credits. Standard is listed at $7/month, Plus at $19/month, and Premium at $29/month when billed annually; higher tiers add unlimited AI, exports, offline access, recording, branding, and analytics.
install: Open https://prezi.com/ and sign up; install the official Prezi desktop app only if your plan includes desktop/offline access.
start: Dashboard → Create with AI (or Start with PPTX/PDF/DOCX), enter a prompt, review the outline, generate, then refine the canvas.

name: Pitches.ai
description: Startup-focused AI pitch-deck generator that researches a company, builds a 12-slide investor narrative, and exports editable PowerPoint or PDF.
bestFor: Founders preparing seed or pre-seed fundraising decks from a company URL, memo, business plan, PDF, PPTX, or spreadsheet.
Teams that need a focused investor story rather than a general-purpose presentation editor.
Users who want the AI to research a public company site, structure the narrative, and then remix slides through studio chat.
Exporting a clean read-ahead PDF or editable PPTX for PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, or a data room.
strengths: Reads supplied sources and can research the company website, including screenshots, to ground the deck in provided context.
Generates a predefined 12-slide seed narrative and offers template slide orders inspired by familiar startup deck structures.
Supports PDF, PPTX, spreadsheets, memos, and public URLs as source material; source numbers should override speculation.
Studio chat can remix and improve slides after generation while preserving the core fundraising workflow.
Exports native editable .pptx files without watermark plus fixed-layout PDF files for investor sharing.
Pitches.ai states private decks, chats, and uploads are not used to train its public AI models and are not sold.
gettingStarted: Open https://www.pitches.ai/ and subscribe or use the available account flow; the service is paid before generation rather than offering a free deck.
Paste your company URL and upload a memo, PDF, PPTX, spreadsheet, or business plan with traction, market, team, and fundraising data.
Let Pitches research the source, then review the proposed 12-slide narrative and correct any unsupported claims or numbers.
Use studio chat to remix slides, adjust messaging, and refine the story for the target investor audience.
Export an editable PPTX for further work in PowerPoint/Google Slides/Keynote or a PDF for email and the data room.
usageNotes: The current public page lists $29/month or $249/year and says there is no free deck or $1 trial; pricing and limits may change.
Pitches is specialized for early-stage investor decks; it is not a broad presentation suite with arbitrary deck types or full slide-design control.
AI research and generated narratives can be incomplete or wrong; verify traction, market sizing, financials, logos, citations, and investor claims against source documents.
Uploading a public URL allows web research and screenshots; avoid confidential materials unless the privacy policy and your fundraising process permit it.
PPTX export is editable but still needs visual and factual QA before sending to investors.
The service uses third-party AI models and may change features, models, limits, or pricing under its terms.
priceDetails: Paid subscription: $29/month or $249/year on the current Pitches.ai page. Generation and export are included after subscription; no free deck or trial is advertised.
install: Open https://www.pitches.ai/ in a browser; no local installation is required.
start: Paste a company URL or upload a memo/PDF/PPTX/spreadsheet, let Pitches build the 12-slide story, then remix in chat and export.

Teams or individuals developing a consistent visual language through Personalization profiles and Moodboards.
Users who prefer a visual community feed and web workflow, with optional Discord access for supported features.

Personalization profiles learn from selected images and apply a preferred aesthetic; Moodboards curate a visual direction for future generations.
Organize provides search, filters, folders, timeline browsing, bulk actions, and downloads across image and video creations.
Midjourney supports image and video generation; current plans provide different Fast/Relax GPU allocations and privacy via Stealth Mode.
The service offers community Explore pages, prompt reuse, style references, and a conversational mode that can write prompts from plain language.
gettingStarted: Create an account and subscribe at midjourney.com; all current plans are paid subscriptions.
Open Create, enter a concrete prompt with subject, composition, lighting, aspect ratio, and constraints, then generate several candidates.
Use image references, settings, or conversational mode to refine intent; save strong results into folders or Moodboards.
Open Editor for Remix, Vary Region/inpainting, Pan, Zoom Out, or edits to an uploaded personal image.
Unlock Personalization by selecting images you like, then enable a profile or use a Moodboard to guide future generations.
Download final assets after checking model version, composition, readable text, likeness, safety, and usage rights.
usageNotes: Current plans are Basic $10/month, Standard $30, Pro $60, and Mega $120; annual billing is listed at 20% off.
Standard, Pro, and Mega include unlimited image generation in Relax mode; unlimited video Relax and Stealth privacy are limited to Pro/Mega according to the current plan table.
GPU time is metered by plan and mode; Fast generation can run out before the subscription period ends, while Relax is slower and plan-dependent.
Generated images can contain incorrect text, artifacts, or unintended resemblance; inspect every asset and do not assume factual or identity accuracy.
Commercial and privacy terms depend on the subscription and current Midjourney policy; review rights and Stealth availability before confidential or client work.
Web-only features such as Editor, Moodboards, Personalization management, and Conversational mode are not identical to Discord features; verify the chosen workflow.
No public developer API was verified in the official documentation reviewed; do not promise API access or local execution.
priceDetails: Paid subscription tiers: Basic $10/month, Standard $30, Pro $60, Mega $120; annual plans are listed at 20% off. Higher tiers add more Fast GPU time, Relax capacity, video, and Stealth privacy.
install: Open https://www.midjourney.com/ and sign in; use the web Create and Editor pages. Discord access is optional for supported workflows.
start: Open Create → type an Imagine prompt → generate candidates → refine with Remix/Editor or Personalization → download the approved result.

description: Image generation and editing platform known for strong text rendering, with Canvas, Editor, Remix, Magic Fill, Extend, Upscale, background tools, batch generation, and an API.
bestFor: Posters, logos, packaging, social graphics, illustrations, ads, concept art, and other visuals where readable typography matters.
Creators iterating on generated or uploaded images with region edits, outpainting, composition changes, and style references.
Teams producing many prompt variants or CSV-driven batches while managing private generations and visual consistency.
Developers integrating image generation and editing into applications through the official Ideogram API.
strengths: Prompt-based generation supports model/version, render speed, quality, aspect ratio, palettes, image references, style references, and private/public visibility controls.

Editor supports crop, resize, zoom, manual composition changes, and prompt-guided remixing of generated or uploaded images.
Tools include Describe, Upscale, background removal/replacement, image upload, personalization/character consistency, and batch generation from CSV.

Ideogram API provides programmatic generation and editing with separate API billing and keys from consumer subscriptions.
gettingStarted: Create an account at ideogram.ai and open the Create page; the free plan provides limited Slow credits and public generations.
Write a prompt describing subject, composition, typography/text, style, aspect ratio, and any constraints; choose model and rendering speed.
Generate several candidates, then use Remix, Canvas, or Editor to correct text, composition, backgrounds, or selected regions.
Use Describe or upload a reference image when you need to extract prompt context or guide style and character consistency.
Save approved assets, set visibility intentionally, and download original PNG where your plan allows; use Batch Generation for CSV-scale variants.
For application integration, enable API Beta, accept the developer agreement, create an API key, and monitor separate API balance and pricing.
usageNotes: Current plans list Free, Plus $20/month, Pro $60/month, and Team $30/member/month (minimum two); annual billing can save up to 20%.

Free includes 10 Slow credits/week and public outputs; Priority credits and private generation require paid access. Credit costs vary by model and rendering quality, and monthly credits expire at cycle end.
The Basic plan is legacy and no longer available for new purchase; rely on the live plans page for current entitlements.
Generated text can still contain spelling or layout errors; inspect typography, trademarks, likeness, safety, and image rights before publishing.
Consumer subscriptions and API accounts are separate, with separate billing and keys; never expose an API key in client-side code.
Cloud processing is required; review privacy, public-by-default behavior on free access, and organizational approval before uploading sensitive images.
priceDetails: Freemium credit system. Free: 10 Slow credits/week. Plus $20/month, Pro $60/month, Team $30/member/month (minimum 2); annual pricing is discounted. API billing is separate.
install: Open https://ideogram.ai/ or install the official iOS app. Developers can use https://developer.ideogram.ai after enabling API access.
start: Open Create, write a prompt, select model/render settings, generate, then refine with Remix, Canvas, or Editor and download the approved image.

For production API use, create an API account/key, estimate costs with the calculator, configure auto top-ups, and monitor usage/concurrency.

Editing operations include image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, background generation/replacement/removal, vectorization, upscale, erase, and variations.

Generate candidates, then refine with inpainting, outpainting, background tools, vectorization, upscale, or style controls.
For consistent branding, create/apply a custom style and specify approved colors, fonts, and visual references.
Download in the needed format (SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF, TIFF, or Lottie where supported) and inspect it in the destination design tool.

usageNotes: Free access includes 30 daily credits renewed every 24 hours; paid plans add higher monthly credits, private generation, uploads, and advanced tools.

install: Open https://www.recraft.ai/ for the web app or https://www.recraft.ai/docs/api-reference/getting-started for API setup. No local runtime is required for hosted generation.
start: Choose a raster/vector model, write a design prompt, generate candidates, refine in the editor, then export the required production format.

Refine with reference images, masks, generative expand/fill, style controls, or manual editing in Photoshop/Illustrator/Premiere/Express.
Review content credentials, output quality, typography, likeness, rights, and brand policy before publishing.

start: Sign in, choose a Firefly generation or edit workflow, write a descriptive prompt, generate variations, and refine/export the approved asset.
